posts.name: Nod by n8n
posts.tagline: Open source personal agent with its own computer
posts.description: Nod does the work around your work, in your apps and on real websites, using a private computer of its own on your Mac or PC. It takes orders only from you, asks before anything you didn't ask for, and runs on the AI provider you choose. Free, Apache 2.0.

posts.name: ScroogeFrog AI
posts.tagline: AI ad fraud detection that protects your marketing budget
posts.description: ScroogeFrog AI helps advertisers find out where their ad budget is going to waste. It audits website traffic and Google Ads campaigns to uncover suspicious clicks, bot activity, and underperforming spend, then turns complex data into clear recommendations on what to fix. For agencies and larger advertisers, it also offers custom AI fraud detection models trained on their own traffic data. Less guesswork, more control over every advertising dollar.

posts.name: CALL-E
posts.tagline: The phone line for AI agents
posts.description: CALL-E lets your AI assistant make phone calls for you. Ask ChatGPT or Claude to book a table, get a quote, move an appointment or check stock. CALL-E asks for anything missing, shows you the plan, and dials a real US or Canadian number after you confirm. It gets through phone menus, hold and voicemail, then brings back a summary, the transcript and what happened. Builders can add it to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or OpenClaw with one prompt. New users get 100 free credits.

posts.name: Scribe v3 by ElevenLabs
posts.tagline: Speech to text with 27% fewer errors in 90+ languages
posts.description: Scribe v3 is ElevenLabs’ most accurate speech-to-text model, for developers building on calls, meetings, interviews and media. It makes 27% fewer word errors than Scribe v2 across 90+ languages. Unlike transcription that breaks on noise, accents and crosstalk, it labels up to 32 speakers, tags laughter, music and emotion, boosts up to 1,000 of your own terms, detects 56 entity types and handles files up to 15 hours. For live use, Scribe v3 Live runs under 150ms.

posts.name: Skillbox
posts.tagline: One library for your AI skills, synced to every agent
posts.description: Skillbox keeps your AI skills in one library and syncs them to Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Follow GitHub sources, review diffs, and scan each version for prompt injection. Trim shortens noisy command output so sessions last longer.

posts.name: MiniMax H3-Image
posts.tagline: Bringing 4K image generation into the 10-second era
posts.description: MiniMax H3-Image is an open-weight model for native 16MP image generation and editing. It uses just six diffusion steps, handles text-to-image and editing in one checkpoint, and supports up to 16 reference images.

posts.name: Relay
posts.tagline: DocSend for AI agents: send and receive docs with context
posts.description: You send a deck or doc. They ask their AI to read it. The AI sees what's on the page, but not the thinking behind it: why you made those choices, what you left out, or what's still open. Relay shares that context with your document, so they and their AI can understand it and ask questions. You choose what to share. Decisions that need your input, like a discount or a date, come back to you. Try a sample relay. No sign-up needed.

posts.name: Shot.video
posts.tagline: Multi-camera videos with the phones you already own
posts.description: Most people record with one camera, because more angles feel too hard. Shot.video turns your laptop and phones into a multi-camera studio. Scan a QR code and a phone becomes another camera, with no app to install. Press record once. Every angle records in sync, then AI makes your first edit. It cuts to the camera you're looking at and adds zooms, punch-ins and optional B-roll. Change anything you like. Free to start. No card needed.

posts.name: Muse Ember by Meta
posts.tagline: Meta's low-cost AI model for high-volume agent tasks
posts.description: Muse Ember is Meta's smallest multimodal reasoning model, built to handle the repetitive work behind AI agents. From tool calls and coding subtasks to document extraction and routing, Ember delivers efficient execution at scale. It supports text, images, audio, and video, with a 1M-token context window and pricing starting at $0.10 per million input tokens. Pair it with larger models for planning, and let Ember handle the volume. Available through Meta Model API and Muse Code.

posts.name: Reddit Reviews
posts.tagline: Product pages that collect subreddit sentiment
posts.description: Discover Reddit Reviews, a new experience that organizes product conversations and highlights the most important takeaways from across our communities.

posts.name: Seedream 5.5 by ByteDance
posts.tagline: ByteDance's AI image model built for 100-round editing
posts.description: Seedream 5.5 is ByteDance's latest AI image model, built for creators who want to keep refining their work without starting over. Make up to 100 rounds of targeted edits while preserving untouched areas at the pixel level. Generate reusable assets with native transparent backgrounds, create more realistic images with natural lighting and textures, and render detailed text more accurately.

posts.name: Valin
posts.tagline: Your private memory for everything you save.
posts.description: For people who save videos, posts, articles and documents across apps and can't find them when they need them, Valin is the private memory app that understands what you save, down to what's said in a video, so you can find information you don't even remember saving. Unlike other AI bookmarking apps, Valin's AI runs entirely on your device, so only you can see what you save. No account, no cloud, no AI subscription.

posts.name: Kippy AI
posts.tagline: Learn languages while having fun!
posts.description: Fluency is hard, being understood is easier. Kippy is your AI speaking partner for language learning. Not your usual AI sycophant tutor but rather personalities that care just a little more about themselves than you, while they teach you a new language.

posts.name: Stiro
posts.tagline: AI onboarding and customer success agent for SaaS
posts.description: Add Stiro to your SaaS with one script tag. When a user gets stuck or asks for something, it does the steps with them in your real product while they watch. Anything that sends, spends or deletes goes back to them. Built to cut how-do-I tickets.

posts.name: Xolace
posts.tagline: For the bad days you wouldn’t call a mental health problem
posts.description: Feeling off but can’t say why? Type it out, or talk it through by voice. Xolace shows you what’s underneath, then hands you steps that fit: a chat with a trained peer supporter, help writing to someone you trust, or guided audio. Reflecting is free.

posts.name: Earlybird
posts.tagline: 29M-param speech-to-text that outputs words before they end
posts.description: Earlybird is a 29M-parameter, 17 MB on-device speech-to-text model that predicts each word correctly about 90 ms before the speaker finishes it, with a confidence on every word. Built for voice agents that need to act sooner. Open weights and code.

posts.name: Mitra MCP
posts.tagline: Give your AI agents access to your personal phone line
posts.description: Most AI agents can’t call. Those that can often use unfamiliar numbers that get blocked or flagged as spam. Even when someone picks up, a successful voice conversation needs different context handling than a text chat. Mitra MCP lets your agent call from your personal number, with a calling experience built for live conversations and the ability to bring you in when needed.

posts.name: StableBar
posts.tagline: A native, open-source menu bar for macOS
posts.description: StableBar is a free, open-source menu bar for macOS written in Swift. Set it up in a Settings window or one JSON file instead of shell scripts. It shows AeroSpace, yabai or OmniWM workspaces, widgets with popups and seven themes, and you edit it on the bar.

posts.name: Subscriptrack
posts.tagline: Connect your email, see every subscription you pay for
posts.description: Connect your email and AI finds every subscription: one list, your monthly total, alerts before renewals and trial ends, cancel steps for 200+ services. Outlook in one click, Gmail and any inbox by forwarding. Never asks for bank logins. Free for 5.

posts.name: Mister Blocks
posts.tagline: Take a picture of your LEGO and AI will make a build
posts.description: Take a photo of the loose bricks on your table. Mister Blocks (powered by Claude) looks at what you actually have and suggests a few things to build from them, each with 3D step-by-step instructions you can turn, zoom and print. Don't like it? Ask the chat for changes. No pile handy? Describe a build in words and get one, from a robot dog to a voxel sculpture of a sports car. Every build is stud-checked. Free guides work offline.

posts.name: Binqo
posts.tagline: A tiny friend in your Mac's notch
posts.description: Binqo puts Mielo, a little dot-matrix friend, in your Mac's notch. Glance up for music, calendar, files and clipboard. Hold a key to ask a question, answered on your Mac. Open the desk for meeting notes and mini-apps you describe in a sentence.

posts.name: RigSpark
posts.tagline: Know which AI to run on your own computer
posts.description: Run open AI models on your own computer: chat, images, video and voice. RigSpark checks your memory, GPU and disk first and shows what will actually run. No account, no cloud, no meter. Free and open source (MIT), in Rust, for macOS, Windows and Linux.

posts.name: Padrail
posts.tagline: Turn your MacBook trackpad edges into controls
posts.description: Padrail turns the edges of your MacBook trackpad into sliders: volume on the right, brightness on the left, keyboard light at the bottom, and a top edge that changes with the app (tabs, zoom, next track). Free, no account, lives in the menu bar.

posts.name: bonds chat
posts.tagline: Multiplayer AI that dies if you and your friends flake
posts.description: Every AI is built for one person. Remember Tamagotchi? 💀 bondi is like one that lives in your friends chat and belongs to the group. Say “30 days of gym” and it sets up the challenge. Everyone checks in with a photo, and doing real things together gives it lives ❤️❤️❤️. Go quiet and it starts losing them. At zero it dies. It also makes games, stickers, countdowns and videos right in the chat. Free on iPhone, web and Mac.

posts.name: Skipbox
posts.tagline: Cheap, fast GitHub Actions runners with unlimited minutes
posts.description: Skipbox runs your GitHub Actions jobs on your own Linux VM, kept between jobs, so Docker layers, package caches and installed tools are still there on the next run. Credentials, the workspace and every container are wiped after each job. A flat monthly price with unlimited minutes: $39 for 4 vCPU / 8 GB. Install the GitHub App and change one line to runs-on: skipbox. 7-day free trial, no card. Private repositories only.

posts.name: nizima ACTION!!
posts.tagline: Powerful editing, expressive characters, zero installs.
posts.description: nizima ACTION!! by Live2D Inc. is a browser video editor that works like a design tool. Despite running entirely in your browser, it delivers advanced editing with nested scenes, precise cuts, and keyframe-based animation. Plus, by using Live2D, the industry standard for VTubers, you can create engaging videos with expressive 2D characters. Free in beta.

posts.name: High Signal
posts.tagline: The best newsletter for bootstrappers
posts.description: Read the bootstrapper news TechCrunch ignores Get revenue updates, acquisition news and marketing tips straight to your inbox for free So you can stop scrolling X all day Grab a free database of startup acquisitions when you join

posts.name: WTFM
posts.tagline: Write the F***ing Manual. Your agent writes the user docs
posts.description: WTFM is a free, open-source plugin for Claude Code and Codex that writes end-user docs from your source code. Ask your agent for a guide and it reads your routes and templates, writes the steps in plain language, and renders a screenshot of every screen from your real UI code. No running app, no manual captures, no account. Output is plain Markdown with images, on your machine. Publish to a hosted help centre on SupportPages.io only if you want to.

posts.name: RomeoSEO Skills
posts.tagline: 48 SEO/AI SEO skills for Claude, Codex, and any other agent.
posts.description: The skills that got me to 25,000 SEO clicks/month. 48 free skills for your agent: Audits, keywords, content, schema and AEO/GEO.

posts.name: DeadAccount.ai
posts.tagline: Brutally honest territory prioritization for Account Execs
posts.description: DeadAccount helps AEs decide which accounts deserve their time, and why. Add the territory you already own. It researches every account, buries the ones that are dead, acquired or out of fit, and gives the rest a Tier 1 to 4 verdict with a source and a date behind each finding. On Pro, you get a plan every Monday: who to work this week and why, with signals and openers tied to what you sell. Try it on 5 accounts free, no card.

posts.name: Puzzle
posts.tagline: The work chart for your AI agents
posts.description: Your AI agents shouldn’t be a black box. Puzzle maps each process step by step, with its owner, a person or an AI agent, and the tools it uses. Connect Claude, ChatGPT or your own agents through MCP, and they work from that same map and log their changes back to it. Your team sees how every agent is set up to work and what it changed, even as agents start passing work to each other. Hand off as much as you want, and you never lose sight of how your business runs.

posts.name: Ascope
posts.tagline: Daily App Store & Google Play keyword ranks, on your Mac
posts.description: Ascope checks where your apps rank in App Store and Google Play search in 50+ countries every day, with popularity and difficulty for every keyword. Native Mac app, no dashboard, no account. Ask Claude or Cursor about your rankings via the built-in MCP server.

posts.name: Delulu Bio
posts.tagline: The link in bio that does more than just list links
posts.description: Delulu Bio is a free link-in-bio for creators, communities and businesses, with no paywall on any feature. Add embeds that play in place (YouTube, Spotify, Maps), shoppable product picks, WhatsApp, Telegram and Discord join cards, contact forms with an inbox, and password gated links. Track clicks with analytics that never store IPs. Connect it to any AI agent via MCP and update your page just by asking. Server-rendered, so it opens instantly from any app.

posts.name: Nimply Design
posts.tagline: Design your social posts right where you schedule them
posts.description: Nimply Design is a design editor built into Nimply, the social media tool. Start from 5,000+ templates in 40 platform sizes, keep every graphic on brand with brand kits, fix photos with AI tools, and turn a flat image back into editable layers with Magic Layers. Or let the Designer agent draft it in your brand. When it is ready, send it straight into a post for approval and scheduling: no downloading and re-uploading. Free plan included. AI tools use credits and show the cost first.

posts.name: BeaconFind
posts.tagline: Find files, photos and recordings by what's inside them
posts.description: BeaconFind finds files by what is inside them, not by their names. Describe a document, a scanned page, a screenshot or a photo and it turns up, by meaning, in 50+ languages and 70+ file types. Since July it also sees and hears: a map of your photos, and on the Balanced and Max tiers people in photos (opt-in) and search inside audio and video with clickable transcripts. The AI runs on your Windows PC or Apple Silicon Mac. Now in the Mac App Store; 14-day trial on the website.

posts.name: TigerGate
posts.tagline: Secure code, cloud and runtime, and stay audit-ready
posts.description: Code-to-cloud security: SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, DAST, CSPM, KSPM, container security, AI-SPM and eBPF runtime protection with compliance automation for SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, HIPAA and CERT-In.

posts.name: Sound Archives
posts.tagline: Discover and stream vintage recordings across archives
posts.description: Explore vintage recordings and historic sounds from six archive collections in one free, streaming-style player. Search, save favorites, and share tracks—with original source links and rights notes. No account or subscription required.

posts.name: Claim Fund
posts.tagline: $13M in unclaimed PumpFun fees. Is any of it yours?
posts.description: Claim Fund lets you check up to 10 Solana wallets for unclaimed creator fees and trader cashback, without connecting. Found something? Connect your wallet to check your live balance and claim what’s yours. No PumpFun login needed. You stay in control, with every transaction approved in your wallet.

posts.name: ExpiredNames.net
posts.tagline: The Complete Domain Intelligence Platform
posts.description: Discover expiring domains across 20 auction sources, explore 30+ years of sales history, track daily registrations, uncover trending keywords, find pending-delete domains, and automate alerts. Includes a powerful developer-friendly API. Start with a free account and explore Pro features with a 7-day free trial.

posts.name: Waymark
posts.tagline: A map that starts in fog and clears where you walk
posts.description: A comprehensive map of everywhere you've been. The map starts out in fog, and every walk, ride or drive clears a little more. Old photos fill in the years before you installed it! No account, no ads, and nothing leaves your iPhone. Free, or $5.99 once for Plus.

posts.name: TicariHesap
posts.tagline: Free pre-accounting for Turkish small businesses
posts.description: TicariHesap is a free online pre-accounting platform built for small businesses, freelancers and entrepreneurs in Türkiye. Manage invoices, customer accounts, inventory, income and expenses, cash, bank transactions and financial reports in one place. Includes online appointment booking and a product storefront integration. The platform is currently available in Turkish. Core pre-accounting features are free forever.

posts.name: Abroad Life: Visas & Residency
posts.tagline: Lifestyle
posts.description: Stop wasting time figuring out how to move to Spain. Abroad turns a complex, fragmented immigration process into one clear journey. Know exactly what to do and when, avoid unnecessary paperwork and costly mistakes, and move forward with the support of AI-powered document checks and a dedicated immigration lawyer. Manage your entire process, track progress and get answers in one place. Less time figuring things out. More time building your life in Spain. Built by migrants, for migrants.

posts.name: Speaklively
posts.tagline: Voice typing for Mac that shows every word as you talk
posts.description: Speaklively is free voice-to-text for Mac. Hold fn and talk, and every word appears in a small panel while you're still speaking, so you're never guessing what it heard. Let go, and the text lands wherever your cursor is, in any app: email, Slack, notes, ChatGPT, Claude. Your voice never leaves your Mac. It works offline and needs no account. No word limit. Optional AI cleanup when you want it. The fastest writer in the room doesn't type. They talk.

posts.name: Turbobulls v2.0
posts.tagline: A budget and portfolio tracker that cannot read your data
posts.description: Seeing all your money in one place usually means letting an app read every number. Turbobulls can't. Your budget and every investment live in one workspace, end-to-end encrypted before it leaves your device. Drop in the files your brokers and banks already give you (60+ supported, no logins), fill envelopes, see where the month went, and follow every holding across currencies. New in 2.0: every page redesigned, Needs a look, payees, a new Breakdown, new imports and many more. Free plan, no card.

posts.name: Live Story
posts.tagline: From design system to live experiences, in one platform.
posts.description: Live Story brings the entire frontend creation process into one platform. Turn your design system, Figma files or AI prompts into responsive digital experiences. Design freely in Studio, build reusable components connected to your content, and publish across websites, apps and digital touchpoints without waiting for development cycles. Seamlessly integrate with your existing tech stack, giving your team more creative freedom while maintaining brand consistency and governance.

posts.name: TomoTomo
posts.tagline: Sync epubs and audiobooks. Image Generation + AI
posts.description: Sync your owned audiobooks and epbus. Generate photos of scenes you're reading. Ask questions about what you're reading. Character Trees to remember who's who.

posts.name: Saviours AI
posts.tagline: All-in-one ICSE Class 10 board prep, from plan to paper
posts.description: Nine AI-powered tools built end to end for the ICSE Class 10 syllabus. Start free. ICSE Class 10 prep is scattered across PDFs, videos and chats. Saviours AI puts it in one place: a smart study planner, a 60-day pre-board plan, timed specimen papers, PYQ practice, history timelines and physics numericals. Start free, Pro is ₹99 one-time.

posts.name: Funes Photo Storage
posts.tagline: See what's taking up space in your iPhone photos
posts.description: A visual map of your iPhone photo library, sized by storage. Find large videos and photos and free up space. Private and on-device.Funes turns your iPhone photo library into a map where every photo and video is sized by its file size. Tap a year, then a month, and find the few long videos filling half your storage. Free, no account, no ads, nothing uploaded.

posts.name: Umber
posts.tagline: Stop copying files. Stream them from one source.
posts.description: Store every image, video, audio file, document and 3D model once, version it, deploy a version to each environment, and serve it to every app from one stable URL — no rebuild or app release to upgrade an asset. Less storage and management cost. Access via Dashboard, REST API and CLI. Free plan available.

posts.name: Ulys
posts.tagline: Ulys is your AI assistant for investing
posts.description: Ulys is an AI agent and mobile app for investing. Describe an idea in your own words and Ulys builds a basket of crypto, tokenized stocks, digital ETFs and digital commodities, then places the trades only when you approve them. Trade, send money to friends, earn yield, and more. Non-custodial, with no seed phrase.

posts.name: Blazly AI
posts.tagline: Let Blazly's AI Assistants Handle SEO, GEO & AEO for You
posts.description: Blazly agents get your site found on Google, cited in AI answers, and published as blogs. Start free with 500 credits.

posts.name: TerraSlides
posts.tagline: Free Online Creative Workspace for Design, Data &  Documents
posts.description: Create illustrations, charts, presentations, documents, and designs in one free online workspace. Professional creative tools with AI and full editing control.

posts.name: Jelly Munch
posts.tagline: The game you grew up with, now glowed up!
posts.description: The snake game you played on your dad's Nokia, rebuilt as a cute jelly. Free, no download.

posts.name: SpacePane for QuickLook
posts.tagline: Press Space. See inside anything.
posts.description: Quick Look previews that show what's really inside a file: hidden text flagged, secrets concealed. Local, read-only and private. Press Space and see what's really inside: JSON as an outline, SQLite as tables, archives as a list. Made on your Mac, read-only, with likely secrets concealed.

posts.name: AISearch Pulse
posts.tagline: 145 technical checks. AI answer tracking. $99 AUD/year.
posts.description: Chrome extension for solo founders and small teams, optimised for Australia. 158 checks in one scan: Title tag, Meta description, H1, content depth, JSON-LD, schema, FAQ, About/Contact signals, Reviews, Location, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, Open Graph, HTTPS, Social links, Trust pages, internal links, and more. 4 scores: SEO, GEO, AEO, AI View. Prioritised fix list with code examples (High/Med/Low). Tracks 1,440 AI answers/year from Perplexity and Gemini. $99 AUD/year. No GST.

posts.name: KI Score
posts.tagline: See how visible your brand is in ChatGPT and AI answers
posts.description: KI Score is the AI visibility index: one score showing how often ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini name your brand versus competitors. Run real buyer prompts, see share of AI voice, cited sources and rank trends. From €39 (about $45)/month, 30-day free trial.

posts.name: Uggs or not?
posts.tagline: A tiny weather app, answering one very important question.
posts.description: The most important weather app you'll ever use. It answer one question and one question only, should you wear Uggs today or not? Because, why not make things that are fun.

posts.name: Dos and Don'ts
posts.tagline: Know before you go...
posts.description: Discover dos and don'ts for places worldwide. Search any city or attraction and get concise, actionable guidance.

posts.name: simplido
posts.tagline: Complete personal productivity solution inspired by GTD®
posts.description: We approach the user's productivity in a holistic manner. Being a list manager is just not enough. We think that real productivity requires synergy between: tools, education, habits and motivation. Inspired by GTD®, essentialism and focusing on a single priority - Simplido combines: tools, education and motivational features to amplify one's sense of fulfillment, productivity, and reduce stress. Delivering cross-platform experience with a Web application and a mobile app for Android and iOS.

posts.name: Vorthra
posts.tagline: Now you can discover who's behind any digital content!
posts.description: AI can create almost anything. But who's behind the content we see and share? Meet Vorthra™ — a new layer of digital trust. Create a verifiable link between your digital files, your identity, and a recorded point in time. Share your Vorthra Record so anyone can independently verify file integrity and identify who stands behind the content. Bring transparency, accountability, and confidence to everything you share.

posts.name: MotorHangar
posts.tagline: Check any car for recalls, free, in 4 languages
posts.description: Official recalls, safety ratings and owner complaints for 13,000+ car models and years, free, no sign-up. See which year to avoid, fuel economy in your units and where to check your VIN in your country. In English, Spanish, German and French.

posts.name: 10xvid
posts.tagline: Video ads for your app, made from your link
posts.description: 10xvid makes motion graphics video ads for apps. Paste your link, and it builds each ad from your real screens, words, colours and logo, ready for Meta and TikTok. Start from a template or one of 100 styles, ask for changes in the chat, and get video ads in 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9, and image ads too.

posts.name: Bottari
posts.tagline: Multiplayer AI for teams that build together
posts.description: Love Claude, but wish it was built for teamwork? Bottari is the multiplayer AI workspace for Claude users. Turn your existing account into a team hub, with full context intact. 🤖 Agent Database: approve an issue, and an agent writes the code and opens the PR, many in parallel. 🙋 Need a human call? A teammate jumps into the session and decides. 💬 Plus: chat in the session and co-edit docs with your team. 🎁 Beta Perk: Free through 2027 if you join NOW!

posts.name: Zuraffa Browser
posts.tagline: Solves all CAPTCHAs with 100% Accuracy.
posts.description: Your agents gets stuck, it sends you a notification, and focus on the tab he needs your help with login, captcha, you solve the captcha, login and your agent continues to work. Scraping a webpage in Italia? Per profile proxy, give your agent an Italian IP. Page services, your agents convert any webpage into an API and you can securely connect with built in secure tunnel, your home computer does your work on your work computer, setup once and any agent can use. Share local mcps with cloud agents!

posts.name: Wingman
posts.tagline: Watches your flight's price and pings you when it drops
posts.description: Wingman is a flight price tracker. Tell it where and when you want to fly: it keeps searching live fares for those exact dates and notifies your phone or computer when the price drops or a faster flight shows up, with a buy-or-wait verdict on every price. It tracks the cheapest and the fastest flight door to door, round trips, self-transfers and every airport of a city, in 16 languages. Free for one round trip; any other trip is a one-time Trip Pass, €1.99 (your first €0.99).

posts.name: Snapify - Screenshot & Full Page Capture
posts.tagline: Capture clean screenshots by removing UI clutter instantly
posts.description: Built Snapify because cleaning screenshots after the fact is annoying. You hide the junk on the page first, then capture. Visible / full page / area / element. Chrome + Firefox. Just shipped a big update + new site. If something’s confusing or broken, reply here — I read these.

posts.name: GazeRank
posts.tagline: Website health + AI search visibility, in one scan.
posts.description: GazeRank helps you understand how healthy, AI-ready, and discoverable your website is. Scan SEO, performance, accessibility, technical issues, and AI search signals in one place—then get prioritized fixes you can act on.Enter a URL, get an AI-read health score with actionable SEO, performance, and accessibility fixes.

posts.name: Jugg.ai
posts.tagline: The unstoppable AI workforce.
posts.description: Hand off the work that never ends. Jugg.ai runs whole functions like support, research and ops with standing AI teams that learn your job, shadow your people, then keep it running 24/7 on your own model key, inside hard spend caps you set.

posts.name: KUHA
posts.tagline: Collect every guest photo with one QR code
posts.description: Your guests captured the best moments. Don't let them disappear into group chats. KUHA brings event photos, videos, and greetings together in one private album using a single QR code. Guests simply scan and share — no app downloads or accounts required. Perfect for weddings, birthdays, corporate events, and celebrations. Give everyone a simple way to contribute, and relive your event through every guest's perspective.

posts.name: Incusia
posts.tagline: Unlimited invoices from $9. The price never moves.
posts.description: Send invoices and estimates, see the moment they're opened, and let automatic reminders chase late payers. Unlimited invoices and clients from $9 a month. Nothing is capped, the price never moves, and you can cancel in one click.

posts.name: The Membrane
posts.tagline: Fail-closed authorization for AI agents in production
posts.description: The Membrane is a self-hosted, fail-closed authorization gateway for AI agents with production write access. Every model and tool call needs a live, signed, time-bounded scope. Each allowed action writes a tamper-evident, hash-linked receipt. A replayed proof, a swapped model or an expired scope is refused; a broken chain severs the agent. Your keys, your models, your policy. Open source (Rust). Clone to a refused call in about five minutes, or watch a recorded replay in the browser demo.

posts.name: Velork
posts.tagline: The IDE for frontend teams
posts.description: Velork is the IDE for everything frontend. Design UIs with AI, add motion and 3D, and turn it all into real code in your favorite stack in one click. Bring your Claude or Codex subscription, or start with 2,000 free AI credits :)

posts.name: Cyber Insurance Application Scanner

posts.description: Paste a carrier cyber application question set, or pick a carrier, and see the ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF 2.0, Essential Eight, CPS 234, CIS Controls v8 and PCI DSS 4.0 controls each question tests, with the evidence to gather and the source question beside every row.

posts.name: Mentide
posts.tagline: Mentide is a private notebook that stays on your device
